title: AI-driven formative assessment and adaptive learning in data-science education: Evaluating an LLM-powered virtual teaching assistant
reasoning: The paper includes a specific section on ethical considerations and uses ethical scenarios (data privacy and consent) as the primary case study for evaluating its Socratic tutoring capabilities. However, the core of the work is benchmarking the pedagogical and technical effectiveness of the learning platform itself, rather than evaluating or benchmarking ethics, morals, or religion as independent constructs.
